beliefs: Each character is shifted by ASCII +1 (a→b, A→B, 0→1, space→!, ~→DEL) [E1, E5, E7]
After the +1 shift, if the original character was a lowercase letter (a–z), the shifted result is uppercased (a→B, b→C, y→Z, z→[) [E2, E6, E7, E8]
Uppercase letters, digits, spaces, and symbols get only the raw +1 shift with no case change (A→B, Z→[, 0→1) [E1, E2, E7]
The uppercase step applies only to results of original lowercase letters, so a shifted uppercase letter like Z→[ stays as '[' and is not uppercased [E7]
The uppercase step applies even when the shifted result is not a lowercase letter, so z→[ (not {) and y→Z [E8]
Only the first character of a lowercase run gets uppercased because subsequent shifted chars are already uppercase; e.g. ab→Bc, not BC [E9]
